description: The optimized single-replica engine the fleet is built from: what tpu-onboarding and tpu-performance produced, as one file.

image.description: The vLLM TPU serving image, by digest when possible.

args.description: `vllm serve` arguments after the model name. --port and --tensor-parallel-size are set by the renderer and ignored here.

fleet.description: How the study relates to the model servers. Absent or mode=managed: the study deploys them from this recipe. mode=adopted: they are already running and owned by someone else; the study only adds the router and benchmarks around them, selects them by these labels, and never applies, scales, restarts or deletes them. Any incumbent path that would change them is refused with ADOPTED_FLEET_IMMUTABLE.

selector.description: Pod labels that select the adopted servers (required when adopted).

service.description: ClusterIP Service in front of the adopted pods; the passthrough control benchmarks against it (required when adopted).

port.description: Port the adopted servers listen on. Default 8000.

replicas.description: Pods the selector is expected to match; `wait` requires this many Ready (required when adopted).

role.description: llm-d role of the adopted pods. Default decode.

chips_per_host.description: Chips one node exposes as google.com/tpu. Required for multi-host replicas (topology.<role>.hosts > 1) unless the generation is pinned (tpu7x: 4).

placement_policy.description: GKE workload (placement) policy name for a multi-host TPU7x node pool; rendered as the cloud.google.com/placement-policy-name node selector.

measured.description: Single-replica saturation facts the planner sizes the fleet from.

knee_rps.description: Highest request rate at which the single replica still met the SLOs.

peak_prefill_throughput.description: Tokens/s of prefill one replica sustains; the affinity filter's peakPrefillThroughput.

peak_decode_throughput.description: Generation tokens/s one replica sustains at its decode knee (TPOT within SLO); with peak_prefill_throughput it sizes the opening xP:yD shape.

source.description: Where this recipe came from (run ids, report paths).

engine_flavor.description: Which connector modules the image carries, as `deploy probe` reports them: tpu-inference's (TPUConnectorHMA / TPUOffloadConnector) or the torchtpu image's own (vllm_torchtpu.*). Picks the kv_connector names the renderer writes for P/D and host-offload arms. `sim` is llm-d-inference-sim: a simulated fleet on CPU nodes that exercises the orchestration (router, pools, LWS groups, P/D via the sidecar, benchmarks) without an accelerator; its `args` are the simulator's own flags.

multihost.description: How a multi-host replica's hosts join up. The renderer places these; it does not know how a given image starts a distributed engine.

worker_command.description: Command the non-leader hosts run (e.g. a ray worker joining LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS, or `sleep infinity` for a simulated group).

env.description: Extra env on every member of a multi-host group (leader and workers).
